decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building is used).
Condition : 4 - The use hereby permitted shall be carried on only by Mrs Shobna Duggal and shall be for a limited period being the period during which the premises are occupied by Mrs Shobna Duggal.

Condition : 5 - The use hereby permitted for hairdressing salon purposes shall not be carried on outside the following times: Tuesday to Saturday 9.00am to 1.30pm and Tuesday to Saturday 4.00pm to 6.00pm, nor at any time on Bank or Public Holidays.

Condition : 6 - The door formed in the south wall of the two-storey side extension shall be removed not later than 3 months from the date of this permission, and the resulting hole in the wall bricked up with materials to match the exisitng, in accordance with Drawing No. 26/101 B received 17 November 2003.
description: Change of use of part of dwellinghouse for use as hairdressing  salon.
